paragraphs: Loop sells municipal websites and apps, and presents them as one platform rather than separate products. The site says those websites carry features that simplify sharing important information with a community. Content on those sites is managed by admin in one place, according to the same page.

The buyers named are municipalities, with the page saying small and medium-sized ones can launch websites and apps with features once only available to larger cities. The site states that work on websites has run for 20 years, with support and services provided to municipalities. One customer is named on the site, Erica Crocker of the Town of Drumheller, whose quote reports how council received a website. Loop is a division of Box Clever Incorporated, as stated in the footer.

quote.text: Small and medium-sized municipalities can now launch websites and apps with advanced features once only available to larger cities.
